statement: For every integer k>=4 define R_k(x)=(x-k+2)A_{k-1,1}(x)+(x-k+3)(x-k+2)A_{k-2,0}(x)/2+(x+1)(x-k+3)A_{k-2,1}(x)+(x+1)(x-k+4)(x-k+3)A_{k-3,0}(x)/2, where A is exactly as defined in source.md and problem.md. If R_k(x)=sum_{r>=0} rho_{k,r} binom(x,r), extended by zero for r<0, then rho_{k,r}>0 exactly for k-2<=r<=2k-1, vanishes otherwise, and rho_{k,r}^2>=rho_{k,r-1}rho_{k,r+1} for every integer r>=0. This is an auxiliary theorem only; neither the j=2 restriction nor the full original Conjecture 3.3 is resolved.
contribution: An all-k log-concavity theorem for the natural lower-mode forcing polynomial in the known recurrence Delta A_{k,2}=(x+1)A_{k-1,2}+R_k. Exact support and a complete 41-prefix polynomial certificate validate the residual part of a possible induction, leaving one precisely stated sufficient mixed inequality unproved. The proof extends the primary source's Abel method; the recurrence, positivity and general method are prior results. No equivalent residual theorem was found in the documented bounded source comparison. Standalone mathematical value and novelty require fresh referee assessment.
